metadata.title: Playlink — Party games, coming soon on mobile
metadata.description: 8 games to liven up your nights with friends: Truth or Dare, Charades, Dilemma and more. The Playlink app is coming soon to iOS and Android.

hero.title: The party games your phone was missing
hero.lede: 8 games, hundreds of cards, playable with friends with no connection needed. Playlink is coming soon to iOS and Android.
